answer: Bindings are kept in pigment, verified in violet, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the falcon check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. Each duplicate costs another 80 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
